mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%) compresses risk-free rates, reducing the discount rate applied to equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS <= 0.5% is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-rate periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A labor market slack condition (UNRATE > 5.5%) signals weak economic activity, leading to reduced corporate earnings growth and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for UNRATE > 5.5% is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in high-unemployment periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a weakening housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction between RSAFS and HOUST shows a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the negative return signal is not observed in > 60% of instances where both RSAFS and HOUST decline by more than 1% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and annual CPIAUCSL > 2.0%), rising interest rates compress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for the condition (FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and CPIAUCSL > 2.0% annually) is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in monetary tightening cycles are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100.0) indicates a weakening manufacturing sector, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for INDPRO < 100.0 is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in manufacturing slowdown periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100.0) signals a weakening manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for INDPRO < 100.0 is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in manufacturing slowdown periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and rise in consumer inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.0% annually) signals a 'soft landing' economic scenario, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction between FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL shows a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the positive return signal is not observed in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and CPIAUCSL > 2.0% annually.

mechanism_narrative: A tight labor market condition (UNRATE < 5.0% and 3-month PAYEMS growth > 0.5%) signals strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 5.0% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: The condition (UNRATE < 5.0% and 3-month PAYEMS growth > 0.5%) is observed, but S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days are negative in more than 60% of those instances.
